decisions.reason: Specifying the Danish date-field help text does not change the mechanism, robustness, or intended use of editable field controls.
The source specifies date-field text but does not change whether placeholder text must clear when a field is activated.
The date-field label has no effect on the required template theme colors.
The date-field label does not alter the task-local assessment method, coverage, time budget, or required outputs.
The source concerns field-help text and does not change any bullet appearance requirement.
An exact date-field help label does not add, remove, or revise any required Word style entry or style-system coverage rule.
The source does not change the expected behavior, test sources, or target version for legacy-to-new copy-paste.
The date-field label is unrelated to Tab-controlled list levels and hierarchy alignment.
The source does not change manual line-break behavior after pasted content.
The date-field help label does not affect table or column stability within page margins.
